changeRecord.title: constraint with the wrong master node
changeRecord.target: constraint floor2: slave B2.2 made master, CM2 detached
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Loads and masses of a floor are applied at the master. If another node is declared master, the node that carries the storey loads is no longer part of the rigid body: a memberless master is left as a loaded node with no stiffness (a mechanism), and a master taken from outside ties the floor to a node that should move independently.
changeRecord.precondition: the model has a rigid constraint

reference.note: the perturbed model is a mechanism: the reference solution is the solver's structured mechanism diagnosis, not a set of results

modes.description: node CM2 is loaded in ux, ry, where it has no stiffness: no member connects to it

problems.message: the structure is a mechanism: node CM2 is loaded in ux, ry, where it has no stiffness: no member connects to it

verification.route: diagnosis tiers N, K, C, E of benchfea.verify (docs/VERIFICATION.md section 4): null space of an independently assembled stiffness, engine matrix, two foreign solvers under a probing load, invariance of the diagnosis; NOT expected to pass: the diagnosis reports a loaded node without any member (cause no-stiffness), and the diagnosis tiers have been measured not to confirm this kind of mechanism (docs/CURVEBALLS.md section 4) -- the pipeline quarantines it

verification.meaning: 'verified' means only: the reference solution passed every tier listed as applicable in this record, at the tolerances stated in it. It does not mean reviewed, approved or certified by anyone.
